_about: The default deck theme for RAPP install packets. This file is DATA: a generator reads it at runtime and renders to it. To brand every deck as your own, copy this file into any public repo, change what you care about, and point DECK_DOGG_URL at your raw URL — no code change, no rebuild, no redeploy. Anything you omit falls back to these values, so a four-colour palette is a complete theme.

_fields.palette: hex colours without '#': ink, paper, accent, accent_soft, muted, rule
_fields.slides: the slide plan itself — reorder, drop or add; a slide whose source is empty is skipped and named in the packet manifest rather than faked
_fields.type: font names and point sizes as strings (the canonical form forbids floats)
_fields.voice: guidance for whoever writes copy against this theme

name: RAPP default

voice.avoid: claims the agent's own contract does not support
voice.tone: plain and specific; state what the agent does and does not do
